Additionally, the name has been used by various monarchs and leaders throughout history, such as King Andrija of Hungary and Croatia, demonstrating its importance and association with power, strength, and history.

Furthermore, many religious figures and saints share this name, like Saint Andrew, further emphasizing its spiritual reverence and association with Christianity.
